description: Pimiento, Maria Alejandra at Universidade da Coruña publishes ISA UV/Vis spectrometer and accompanying wastewater-probe observations through Co-UDlabs. A campus drainage monitoring setup uses a sedimentation hopper, an analysis tank, a spectrometer, pH/turbidity/conductivity sensors and an autosampler. The campaign supports evaluation of new pollutant-load and hydraulic monitoring technologies. Coverage is the University of A Coruña controlled wastewater system in Spain; measurement dates and time steps are unspecified. Zenodo provides a dataset ZIP and descriptive PDF with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the source does not give calibration equations, all analytes or agreement with laboratory samples, and settling before analysis may affect interpretation of monitored wastewater. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
